best_bets.rule: Per game, the single selection with the highest EV among those with model P > 50%, EV > 0 buying at the Polymarket ask (YES or NO) including the taker fee, where the bet probability is the model shrunk 50% toward the market mid; raw model-minus-ask edge at most 8 pts; traded volume at least 500; team totals and BTTS excluded. Match-result bets also require agreement from the two highest-weight components; otherwise NO BET.
best_bets.ev_formula: EV per $1 = (mid + w * (p_model - mid)) / (ask + fee per contract) - 1
best_bets.markets: full-time goals markets priced from the frozen score grid: 1X2 (YES/NO), totals, spreads, exact score. Half-time, corners and first-to-score are not modelled.
